algorithm.name: 阶段迁移与Attention结构守卫统一构造
algorithm.method: Single-cut exact stages; ordinary fixed/rotating repeated stages; closed attention and FFN packing; otherwise preserved guarded tree policy. Structure-driven direct construction; one E0 for direct routes, at most two for guarded with certified pruning. No historical plan lookup.

offline_costs: No training or graph-specific scored lookup; archived research/census/formal cases are development evidence only. Dependency install/source verification and actual dispatch environment retained by producer. No E1/E2 or Colab in this manifest.
